preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 2 and 1000, inclusive.
Each edge connects two vertices within the range of vertex IDs.
No self-loops or multiple edges are present.
The graph is a connected acyclic graph.

postconditions.expression: The output is '! r' where r is the root vertex of the tree.
postconditions.description: The output identifies the root vertex of the tree.

invariants.expression: The number of queries is at most floor(n/2).
invariants.description: The number of queries Kuroni can make is limited to half the number of vertices.
